subject: general
question: Which of the following states became the first Indian State to enact 'Right to Health Act 2022 ?
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Rajasthan**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajasthan** became the first Indian state to enact the **'Right to Health Act 2022'**.
 
• The act aims to provide every citizen with access to **quality healthcare services and facilities**.
 
• It also includes provisions for **free medical treatment **and** medicines** for certain categories of people.
 
• The act also establishes a **state health commission** to oversee the implementation of the act.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Punjab:**

 
 
• Punjab has launched a universal health insurance scheme called** Sarbat Sehat Bima Yojana**.
 
• In order to provide better health outcomes, the Punjab government's Sarbat Sehat Bima Yojana offers** cashless services **and** incentive money** in the form of health insurance.
 
 
 
• **Haryana:**
 
 
• Haryana has launched a scheme called** Mukhyamantri Muft Ilaaj Yojana.**
 
• It provides **free medical treatment** to certain categories of people.
 
 
 
• **Madhya Pradesh:**
 
 
• Madhya Pradesh has launched a scheme called **Ayushman Bharat Madhya Pradesh Niramayam Yojana.**
 
• **It** provides** free medical treatment **and medicines to certain categories of people.
